model.name: Task 26.1: Federated IOR — provenance via originHost
model.description: An IOR gains an OPTIONAL host suffix (ior:instance:<uuid>@<originHost>) so a reference is resolvable across servers; local IORs omit @host (implicit self), 100% back-compatible. An imported unit records provenance in model.originHost + model.originIor. Resolution is polymorphic via a pluggable loader registry: no-@host resolves locally (ScenarioIndex.get), @remote via a registered federated loader (fetch), so a federated IOR dereferences lazily anywhere it appears.
model.intention: RawBin Federation (Tron 2026-07-01: dragging items between two RawBin servers). Principle: STRUCTURE eager, PAYLOAD lazy, IDENTITY by-reference. R26.1 = the federated IOR + resolver foundation.
model.context: Greenfield federation, scenario-first (#126) — full design-ahead chain minted BEFORE the expert codes. Design: scrum.pmo/design-notes/federated-scenario-transfer.md (architect 7e940cf81). Class IOR / resolver.

model.acceptanceCriteria:
- [ ] (format) The IOR string supports an optional host suffix: ior:instance:<uuid>@<originHost>; a local IOR omits @host (implicit self) and stays 100% back-compatible with every existing ior:instance:<uuid>
- [ ] (provenance) An imported unit stores provenance: model.originHost (source server canonical https:// URL) + model.originIor (the original ior:instance:<uuid>@host). Local-born units omit both
- [ ] (resolver) Resolution is polymorphic via a pluggable loader registry: no-@host/@self -> local ScenarioIndex.get; @remote -> a registered federated loader (fetches via R26.3), keyed on @host exactly as FileLoader is registered locally
- [ ] (resolver-lazy) A federated IOR can be dereferenced lazily anywhere it appears (ISR-style), not only at import
- [ ] (identity) originHost is the server's canonical https:// origin (reuses per-server host identity), never an IP
